verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a payments platform with many APIs (Legal Entity Management, Configuration) could publish an OpenAPI spec. However, nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable machine-readable spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing features, not an API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
